recognize_zh: 視野中有數顆大小不一的淋巴樣細胞，細胞核有缺刻、摺疊或呈 U 形／腦迴狀輪廓（上右與下中央最明顯），染色質粗、細胞質少，與旁邊正常的單核球及桿狀嗜中性球不同，提示皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤的異常淋巴球侵犯骨髓。
features: Atypical lymphoid cells of variable size with scant to moderate blue cytoplasm
Nuclear contours notched, folded or U-shaped with convoluted cerebriform outlines (upper right, lower center)
Coarsely clumped, condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Smaller lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei (right, lower left)
Adjacent monocyte with folded nucleus and vacuolated gray cytoplasm and a band neutrophil (upper left) for comparison
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several lymphoid cells of variable size with scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm and irregular nuclear contours, including notched, U-shaped and convoluted cerebriform nuclei with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A monocyte and a band neutrophil are present for size comparison. No blasts are seen in this field. In a patient with known cutaneous T-cell lymphoma, the findings are consistent with marrow involvement by atypical cerebriform T cells, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry (e.g. CD4+ with loss of CD7/CD26) or immunohistochemistry on the biopsy.

ddx.vs: Shows more pronounced polylobated flower cells, CD25 positivity and HTLV-1 infection.
Reactive lymphocytes have round nuclei with abundant cytoplasm and lack a phenotypically aberrant CD4+ population.
Small round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, with a CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
Have lacy chromatin, abundant gray vacuolated cytoplasm and nonspecific esterase positivity, unlike the dense chromatin of cerebriform lymphocytes.
